## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (92%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 surgical frozen section suggests invasive carcinoma [F1] involving all four margins [F7] despite severity-3 stain degradation.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 92%, InSitu 8%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Strong invasive risk score |
| Conformal set | Invasive (10% alpha, 90% test coverage) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 94% OOD, 12/12 regions kept [F6] | Passes QC despite high OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (79–85%); InSitu contrast 77% [F5] | All nearest neighbors match suggestion |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 0, 4, 8) · context · High score (+1.56) pushes away from invasive (-1.52) [F2]; 8/20 spot-checked · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-0.73) pushes toward invasive (+1.06) [F3]; unreliable (0/20 spot-checked) · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-1.21) pushes toward invasive (+0.91) [F4]; caption inconsistent · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-0.95) pushes toward invasive (+0.88); separates InSitu contrast · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 0, 2, 4) · ↑ invasive · High score (+1.71) pushes toward invasive (+0.37); unreliable (3/20 spot-checked) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops P(invasive) beyond random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064); leans on unreliable normal_lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 stain degradation on this simulated frozen section (94% OOD) mimics tubule or stromal loss versus InSitu (8%).
- High-similarity InSitu contrast case BACH_0063 (77%) and disabled cell segmentation mask in-situ disease or overcall margins.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 3, 2**: Highest risk (99%, 91%, 77%); confirm stromal invasion and pleomorphism over stain artifact.
2. **Regions 5, 8**: Verify scarce tubules/stroma (region 5, 71% risk) and stromal infiltration with TILs (region 8).
3. **Regions 0–3, 8–11**: Inspect positive margins (inferior 860 um, superior 538 um, lateral 430 um, medial 323 um).
